title.narrative: Lifesaving Health and Nutrition support to Sudanese Refugees in Libya

description.narrative: Provide immediate and life-saving health and nutrition services to Sudanese refugees and host communities, focusing on the most vulnerable children, women, and their families. UNICEF is coordinating with the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), Primary Health Care Institute (PHCI) and local health authorities to ensure that the response is aligned with the MOH response plan. Also, the interventions were designed in a system strengthening approach so that we respond to the emergency and leave behind a resilient health system capable of absorbing any future shocks. Moreover, UNICEF is boosting its human resource capacity in the field to accelerate field-based operations. Interventions will include: • provision of essential medical equipment, supplies and consumables.• emergency repair of selected health facilities • WASH interventions to support health outcomes.• ensuring immunization coverage for Sudanese children under five years of age against vaccine-preventable diseases • emergency training of healthcare workers in the targeted municipalities• the provision of emergency nutrition services including capacity building on nutrition in emergencies, nutritional screening, and awareness raising about Infant and Young Child Feeding (IYCF) practices along with distributing preventive nutrition commodities
